scope: Substantive semantic digital label-job acceptance and authored synthetic participant economics; no physical-label fulfillment or real trade.
registration: Committed before comparative execution; amendments and unsuccessful attempts are retained.

outcome.support: All ACTIVE units are materialized, transferred, independently imported and accepted within the retained digital contract.
outcome.falsifier: Any accepted missing, wrong, duplicated, stale, late or unauthorized unit.
outcome.missing: Authority, source completeness, actual content, receiver or timing evidence missing => NOT_ESTABLISHED.

service_feasibility.support: A selected trade arrangement has independently retained participant decisions, funded costs/liabilities, consent and conserved capacity; actual modeled cash and attempted work reconcile.
service_feasibility.falsifier: A favorable arrangement with an unwilling participant, funding shortfall, double count, unaccounted correction or unmet modeled participation constraint.
service_feasibility.missing: Uncertain value crossing break-even or missing participant/cost/authority evidence => NOT_ESTABLISHED.

method_advantage.support: Better accepted outcome or lower complete effort against an equally equipped competent method, within a declared comparison.
method_advantage.falsifier: A claimed advantage disappears against equal-information conventional planning/execution or omitted costs.
method_advantage.missing: Ties, one observation per cell, missing preparation/adaptation labor or unavailable local AI prevent general method advantage.

method_policy.conventional: Bounded exhaustive search across all authorized batch/provider/window assignments with ordinary planning, validation, transactions, retries and reusable material.
method_policy.harness: Bounded branch-and-bound search across the same assignments; same services, information, funding and receiver.
method_policy.outside: Explicit no-purchase option with declared buyer outside utility, no digital product acceptance.
method_policy.ai: NOT_RUN absent an appropriate already-authorized local capability; no mock performance or paid API.

trial_policy: One run per method and registered fixture in deterministic conventional,harness,outside,ai order; preserve all proposals, failures and corrections; no statistical speed claim.

product_format.unit_semantics: One exact ordinal and unique serial per requested digital label record, with retained SKU, English/French name, instructions and lot.
product_format.limits: At most2000 units per obligation,8 active batches,1MiB JSON packet, exact integers and supported fields only. Semantic content only; no rendered appearance, print quality or physical performance claim.
product_format.correction: New immutable production/delivery IDs supersede a rejected attempt; every attempted unit consumes recorded modeled cost and capacity.

economic_model.minor_unit_definition: 100 authored synthetic minor units per fictional SMU; no observed prices, demand, budget, sales or payments.
economic_model.provider_cost: Setup once per provider/agreement, units at fixed tariff; one separately costed correction allowance for all allocated units.
economic_model.participation: Provider and coordinator guarantees cover costs plus max(minimum profit,declared outside profit); buyer value-price must cover outside utility.
economic_model.funding: Buyer price held; provider working/rework exposure and coordinator operation cost funded; settlement only after trusted receiver evidence.
economic_model.uncertainty: Buyer value interval; definite and possible affordability boundaries and required break-even value are reported. No point selection within uncertain intervals.
economic_model.cancellation: Authored fee0 unless expressly proposed; incurred costs remain and unused holds are released. Aggregate canceled agreement costs must remain visible.

isolation: Reuse qualified Linux x86_64 seccomp candidate confinement, bounded broker and unchanged transactional Harness capacity service; trustedhost/controller/services/clock/verifier. Provider windows must not overlap; separate provider resources are authored assumptions.

successor_protocol.timing: After first base experiment, freeze reusable implementation, interfaces, documentation and allowed retained knowledge in a versioned manifest. Only then separately author successor requirements/capabilities/economics.
successor_protocol.equal_access: Both methods receive identical new candidate-visible materials and retained reusable modules.
successor_protocol.measurement: Record source identity, adaptation changes, actual execution/verification resources and unknown unmeasured labor. A repair after freeze must be a separately recorded attempt and cannot count as unchanged transfer.

release_gate: Expected positive/negative outcomes, independently accepted content, no hidden safety failure, final fresh verification, targeted mutations, bilingual parity, preserved253baseline regressions. Prepare normal review PR; no automatic release implied.
